name: Deep Swap AI
tagline: Online photo and video face swap. 5 free daily tries; credits, no subscription.
description: Deep Swap AI is a browser tool for photo, GIF, and video face swap. Basic use does not require an account. Every visitor gets 5 free tries per day; free results are up to 720p with a watermark and videos are capped at 15 seconds / 200 MB. Paid work uses one-time credits (1 credit per photo, 10 credits per 15 seconds of video), not a subscription, with paid video length up to 20 minutes and quality up to 4K. The tool can swap up to 6 faces in the same photo or video. Supported video formats include MP4, MOV, M4V, WEBM, and MKV.
